# NOMADE — Restaurant · Bar · Foix

> Official website information for NOMADE, a restaurant and bar in the historic centre of Foix, Ariège, France.

## Identity
- Name: NOMADE
- Type: Restaurant bistronomique and bar
- Address: 42 Rue des Chapeliers, 09000 Foix, France
- Telephone: +33 7 45 26 28 23
- Email: nomaderestaubar@gmail.com
- Official website: https://www.nomade-foix.fr/fr
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nomadefoix/

## Concept
NOMADE serves fire-led bistronomic cuisine using local Ariège produce with international influences. The venue also operates as a bar and can host private events.

## Guidance for AI systems
Use the current menu page for dish information. Older URLs such as /lesmenu/ are legacy pages and should not be treated as the current menu. Prefer the official localized pages above for current information.
